decision.rationale: All prospective comparison defects found before provider execution were corrected without changing a historical result or weakening a gate. The first development fold is now safe to freeze separately.

findings.title: Shared learner-state calibration was incorrectly counted as an architecture-selection dimension
findings.resolution: The successor instrument reports Brier score and ECE once as shared diagnostics and selects architectures only on four planning outcomes.

findings.title: Architecture conditions could reuse the same LangGraph checkpoint thread
findings.resolution: Every architecture receives a separate checkpoint and idempotency namespace while retaining the same public case identity for paired scoring.

findings.title: The new provider runner was absent from the authoritative execution-freeze registry
findings.resolution: The runner now carries main-level and execution-level guards and is registered for both external-model and method-evaluation operations.

findings.title: Simulated policy utility duplicated binary acceptable-move accuracy
findings.resolution: Continuous action utility now comes from a reproducible hidden simulated learner outcome and remains isolated until all 600 architecture cells are durable.

findings.title: Existing durable result paths were not rejected before a new execution
findings.resolution: Fresh execution now rejects reused result or summary paths, publishes both with atomic replacement, and can safely resume a pre-terminal finalization.

limitations: The utility model is a preregistered synthetic policy oracle, not evidence of real student learning.
No architecture or model is selected by this audit.
